competitors.name: Red's All Natural / Kroger
competitors.action: Red's All Natural expanded its Kroger-exclusive frozen Snackers line with two additional mini burritos: Grilled White Meat Chicken & Cheese and Bean & Cheese. The new varieties adapt flavors from Red's full-size burrito range into kid-sized formats positioned for lunchboxes, after-school hunger, pre-practice eating and quick weekend lunches.

trends.topic: Frozen brands extending full-size products into retailer-exclusive, kid-sized snack formats
trends.magnitude: Two additional mini burrito varieties joined Red's Kroger-exclusive Snackers line after its initial four-SKU launch in June 2026.
trends.context: This is an expansion of a previously reported Kroger-exclusive line, not a new brand launch. It is still a concrete shelf delta: Red's is using established burrito flavors and explicit family occasions to deepen its frozen-snacking assortment at one national retailer. Alongside Kroger's newly launched Incredifulls PB&J Cups, the move suggests the account is giving more freezer space to portable products with a sharply defined kid and family job. Real Dough should keep its own Kroger pitch equally explicit about the meal occasion it wins rather than relying on premium quality alone.

market_data.value: Two additional mini frozen burrito varieties
market_data.change: Grilled White Meat Chicken & Cheese and Bean & Cheese extend the four-SKU Snackers line first launched at Kroger in June 2026

breaking.headline: Red's All Natural Releases Two Mini Burritos at Kroger
